blocks.title: Open AI Canvas in Astravia
blocks.description: Run the open-source AI canvas locally and interact with it through the host agent. Text-to-image, image-to-video, and more — all from your workspace.

showcase.user_prompt: List my canvas projects and create a new one for the product launch video.
showcase.assistant_reply: I found 3 projects. Created project 'Product Launch Video'. You can now open it in the canvas to add nodes.

items.title: Full canvas, locally hosted
items.description: The complete open-ai-canvas backend and frontend run on your machine. All data stays in the plugin's data directory.

items.title: Host agent control via MCP
items.description: Manage projects, canvases, nodes and generation tasks directly through the host agent using MCP tools.

items.title: One-click lifecycle
items.description: Start and stop the canvas from the workspace view. The host manages the Go backend, Node runtime, and agent process.

items.title: External browser access
items.description: Open the full canvas UI in your default browser for the complete experience, including real-time collaboration.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: Install from the marketplace. The plugin bundles the Go backend, frontend, agent runtime, and model channel plugins.

items.title: Start the canvas
items.description: Open the workspace view and click 'Start Canvas'. A built-in progress page tracks the first-time runtime download; the canvas opens automatically once the backend is ready.

items.title: Open and log in
items.description: Click 'Open in Browser' to open the canvas UI. The first user can register automatically.

items.title: Use the agent
items.description: After logging in, the host agent can manage your projects and canvases via MCP tools.

blocks.content: The canvas requires model API keys (OpenAI, Stability AI, etc.) to generate content. Configure them in the canvas UI under model channel settings. Keys are stored locally in the plugin's SQLite database.

First launch downloads a ~207 MB runtime (backend + web app) from GitHub Releases and verifies its checksum before starting. Expect several minutes on a slow connection; later launches start immediately. The runtime is stored under the plugin's data directory.
